title: Graph tab: deterministic SVG over catalogue and mapped-object lines
summary: Open Database Lab, choose a database and select the Graph tab. OodDatabaseLab~graphLines(extraLines) emits LF-separated, tab-delimited TABLE table rowCount; COLUMN table column type nullable(0/1) primary(0/1) unique(0/1); FK childTable childColumn parentTable parentColumn onDelete; it appends OBJECT/PART lines supplied in extraLines. The browser consumes these lines, never SQL or ::ANNOTATE. It draws deterministic SVG tables and typed columns, PK/UNIQUE marks, ON DELETE-labelled foreign-key arrows, and compact junctions for pure two-parent link tables. Selecting a table box loads it in the schema editor. The optional mapped-object textarea id is dbObjectLines, refresh button id dbGraphRefresh, and SVG output container id dbGraph. For an object-bound Designer form, OodBoundGraph maps its class and part targets into ObjectStore and fills dbObjectLines without overwriting user-entered text. OBJECT class primaryTable and PART class attribute|'-' EXT|ONE|MANY|LINK targetTable linkTable|'-' OWNED|SHARED come directly from ObjectStore~graphLines (see mapped-objects.graph-lines); graphLines(extraLines) passes them through. Schema-qualified names match unqualified table names case-insensitively; unknown future record kinds are ignored. The renderer outlines mapped objects and draws typed part edges; labels come from OodUi English/German db.* resources. Since v0.1.3, drag from a parent PK/UNIQUE column to a child column to create a real FK (see oodialog-database-lab.drag-relationships). Page implementation: animatedads/oorexx PR #3 based on Designer v0.13; DOM test 30/30 PASS.
invariants: No SQL-text parsing or annotation parsing in the browser: catalogue and ObjectStore graphLines are the two authorities.
Input is tab-separated lines joined by LF, never JSON or a browser reconstruction of the object map.
Map each class of interest in ObjectStore before asking for graphLines: only mapped classes are listed.
Maintain stable ids dbObjectLines, dbGraphRefresh and dbGraph for Designer integration.
The same lines produce the same SVG layout; table choice invokes the existing schema loader.

provenance.claim: Model graphLines record contract, diagram and relationship authoring.
